content:
Track: Advanced SQL Querying
   - Lesson 1: Subqueries and Nested Queries
   - Lesson 2: Joins (Left, Right, Inner, Outer)
   - Lesson 3: Self-Joins and Cross Joins
   - Lesson 4: Data Manipulation (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE)
   - Lesson 5: Transactions and Constraints
   - Lesson 6: Views and Stored Procedures
   - Lesson 7: SQL Aggregate Functions beyond SUM and COUNT
   - Lesson 8: Window Functions (ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK)
   - Lesson 9: Working with JSON data in SQL
   - Lesson 10: Optimizing SQL Performance

   Track: Python for Data Analysis
   - Lesson 1: Python Essentials and Libraries Introduction (NumPy, pandas)
   - Lesson 2: Reading and Writing Data Formats (CSV, Excel, SQL)
   - Lesson 3: Cleaning and Preprocessing Data (handling missing values, data types)
   - Lesson 4: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) with pandas
   - Lesson 5: Visualizing Data with Matplotlib
   - Lesson 6: Working with Time Series Data
   - Lesson 7: Grouping and Merging Data in pandas
   - Lesson 8: Data Transformation Techniques (melting, stacking)

   Track: Statistics for Data Analysis
   - Lesson 1: Descriptive Statistics
   - Lesson 2: Probability Distributions (Normal, Exponential, Poisson)
   - Lesson 3: Hypothesis Testing and Confidence Intervals
   - Lesson 4: Correlation and Regression Analysis
   - Lesson 5: Analyzing Categorical Data (Chi-Square Test)
   - Lesson 6: Nonparametric Tests
   - Lesson 7: Introduction to Machine Learning Algorithms
   - Lesson 8: Evaluating Model Performance

   Track: Excel for Data Professionals
   - Lesson 1: Power Query (Power BI)
   - Lesson 2: PivotTables and Slicers
   - Lesson 3: PowerPivot and DAX Formulas
   - Lesson 4: Building Dashboards in Excel
   - Lesson 5: VBA Programming for Data Automation
   - Lesson 6: Macro Recording and Debugging
   - Lesson 7: Creating Custom Functions
   - Lesson 8: Advanced Charting Techniques (Waterfall, Sankey Diagrams)

   Track: Introduction to Machine Learning
   - Lesson 1: Supervised Learning Algorithms (Linear Regression, Logistic Regression)
   - Lesson 2: Unsupervised Learning Algorithms (K-Means Clustering, Hierarchical Clustering)
   - Lesson 3: Evaluating Model Performance and Validation Techniques
   - Lesson 4: Decision Trees and Random Forests
   - Lesson 5: Ensemble Methods (Bagging, Boosting)
   - Lesson 6: Neural Networks
   - Lesson 7: Hyperparameter Tuning and Grid Search
   - Lesson 8: Deploying Machine Learning Models

   Track: Cloud Platform Fundamentals
   - Lesson 1: Introduction to AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure
   - Lesson 2: Setting Up a SQL Database on the Cloud
   - Lesson 3: Data Storage Options (S3, GCS, Blob Storage)
   - Lesson 4: Data Processing Services (Glue, BigQuery, Databricks)
   - Lesson 5: Machine Learning Services (SageMaker, AutoML Tables, Azure ML Studio)
   - Lesson 6: Containerization and Orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
   - Lesson 7: Security Best Practices for Cloud Data
   - Lesson 8: Scaling and Optimizing Cloud Infrastructure

   Track: Business Intelligence and Reporting
   - Lesson 1: Dashboard Design Principles
   - Lesson 2: Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   - Lesson 3: Balanced Scorecards
   - Lesson 4: Storytelling with Data Visualizations
   - Lesson 5: Creating Interactive Reports
   - Lesson 6: Data Discovery and Data Mining Techniques
   - Lesson 7: Root Cause Analysis (Drill-down, Drill-through)
   - Lesson 8: Automating Reports with Scheduled Tasks and APIs
